q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of wire nails per kg?
title: Wire nails carbon footprint per kg
short: Multiply the wire rod per kg of nails by the steel supplier's figure, then add drawing, nail making, polishing and packing energy. Divide the unit's energy by kg dispatched.

p: Report per kg. The wire rod usually carries most of the footprint.

example.title: Worked example: wire nails unit per kg (one month)
lines: Plant total: 14,200 / 200,000 = 0.0710 kg CO2 per kg
Add wire rod for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
